blindness_class: historical sealed-measurement holdout; not analyst-naive blind
claim_ceiling: Object-, cutoff-, dataset-, model-, and holdout-specific physical-validation test only; not universal JX validation, an engine superiority claim, or a Planet-X result.
immediate_next_action: Implement and audit only the curator/seal mechanism before any object-specific observation download.

model_contract.covariance: training-only normal system with at most one preregistered robust variance-inflation factor
model_contract.estimation: weighted nonlinear least squares of a six-dimensional state at a declared TDB epoch using training observations only
model_contract.nongravitational_parameters: forbidden unless a prospectively specified training-only significance gate activates them before prediction sealing
observation_model: applicable aberration and relativistic light deflection without double correction

permitted_preseal_data: MPC ADES-2022 target observations with observation time strictly before cutoff
JPL small-body radar astrometry with measurement epoch strictly before cutoff
frozen leap-second and IERS Earth-orientation tables
frozen JPL DE441 major-body ephemeris and declared constants/kernels
primary_question: Can a JX orbit-determination and propagation pipeline fit only pre-cutoff target observations and predict withheld optical/radar measurements through the 2013 Earth encounter and post-encounter motion?
prohibited_preseal_data: post-cutoff optical or radar measurement values
current target SBDB orbit or covariance
target-specific Horizons vectors, elements, SPKs, observer ephemerides, close-approach tables, or B-plane values
published encounter numbers used as numerical fit constraints
sealed_predictions: topocentric RA/Dec for every optical holdout schedule row
radar delay/Doppler for every radar schedule row
threshold_policy: All numeric thresholds must be frozen in a training-only Threshold Addendum before unblinding; otherwise verdict INVALID_BLIND.
unblinding_rule: One logged manifest-verifying unblind; no post-unblind refit, threshold change, force addition, observation deletion, or code modification may alter the preregistered verdict.
